about_short_description.short_description: Warrant develops APIs and infrastructure to help developers add authorization and access control to their apps.

product.name: Authorization & Access Control Platform
product.description: A platform that enables developers to define, manage, and enforce authorization models and access control policies across applications and services.

product.name: Server-side Authorization SDKs
product.description: SDKs for backend languages and frameworks to integrate permission checks into API routes and business logic.

product.name: Client-side Authorization Components
product.description: Drop-in components for frontend frameworks to build UIs that respond dynamically to user permissions.

product.name: Management Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard for managing user access, roles, and permissions across applications and teams.

product.name: Low/No-Code Self-Service Workflows
product.description: Prebuilt, hosted pages that enable delegated, self-service access management with minimal coding.

product.name: Comprehensive Audit Logs
product.description: Logs that record all authorization model changes and access decisions for monitoring and compliance.
